entries.derivation: Geometry was derived, not copied verbatim: the source SVG's filled calligraphic-stroke outlines were converted to single-line centerline trajectories (via boundary-chain pairing), stroke grouping/order was recovered from the source's gray-to-black stroke-reveal frames, and direction/start-point was recovered from the source's start-position markers. Coordinates were then rescaled into the app's 0-300 canvas.
